Brief review 2026-09-18 (Belt grinder creative hub) — this brief has 2 errors the editor must know about:
1. Every line promises terms the store does not offer: `Testa den … i 30 dagar`, `Du får pengarna tillbaka`, `riskfritt` — the product page says `Du har 14 dagars ångerrätt enligt lag` and never mentions 30 days (read live from the product page 2026-09-21); free shipping within Sweden, 5–10 working days and Klarna are true (site banner). Do not reuse this ad; a trust static must say the real terms (free shipping within Sweden, 5–10 working days, Klarna, 14 days' right of withdrawal by law).
2. The sub-line `Fungerar den inte på Bälteslipmaskin Mini? Du får pengarna tillbaka.` is broken Swedish — it does not mean "Not happy with your Belt Grinder Mini?". Never bake a line in until the Swedish has been read back by a Swedish speaker.
Fix before production. If the ad is already live, apply it to the next version — nothing is paused. Status unchanged.
